name: MDE.tv
description: Million Dollar Extreme content from MDE.tv: every video series, audio series and screed writer shows up as a creator; log in to play members-only content.
author: Unofficial

authentication.userAgent: Mozilla/5.0 (Linux; Android 14) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/129.0.0.0 Mobile Safari/537.36
authentication.loginWarning: Open the menu at the top of the MDE.tv page and sign in. Grayjay saves your session and closes this window as soon as you're logged in.

settings.name: Show screeds on Home
settings.description: Mix MDE.tv screeds (articles) into the Home feed alongside new episodes.

settings.name: Count Grayjay viewing on MDE.tv
settings.description: When logged in, report what you watch in Grayjay to MDE.tv the same way the website's player does, so it counts toward watch time and achievements. Episodes are marked finished after 95%.

settings.name: Debug logging
settings.description: Write API errors and details to the Grayjay log (useful for fixing the plugin if the site changes).

settings.name: Include audio series
settings.description: Add the Listen section's audio series (podcast audio, music, soundtracks) as creators when importing subscriptions and searching.

settings.name: Offer MP4 qualities
settings.description: Add the site's MP4 download files (1080p/720p/480p, when an episode has them) as extra quality options. Useful for downloads and casting.

1: Initial version: series as creators, subscription import, login for paid videos
2: Login now starts on the MDE.tv home page and completes when the MDE.tv session cookies are set
3: Rewritten to use the MDE.tv API: videos now play (signed HLS streams)
Screeds added as posts, with each writer as a creator
Import subscriptions adds every series and writer
4: Episodes you watch in Grayjay are marked watched on MDE.tv (when logged in)
Episodes marked watched on MDE.tv show as watched in Grayjay
5: Episodes are only marked watched on MDE.tv after playing past 95%, matching the website
6: Grayjay viewing now counts toward MDE.tv watch time and achievements (sends the same playback reports as the website's player)
7: Comments and replies on episodes and screeds (newest first, pinned comments on top)
8: Fix: leaving a video no longer marks it watched; only playing past 95% does
9: Audio (Listen) series as creators, playable as MP3
MP4 1080p/720p/480p qualities when the site has download files for an episode
Chapter markers when an episode has chapters
10: Imports your MDE.tv watch history into Grayjay's history (on startup, or Sources → MDE.tv → Sync history)
